svg.title: P1 · Deployment overview
svg.text: one Docker host · Docker Engine + Compose · linux/amd64 or linux/arm64 · host choice open (EN01-U3)
UML deployment diagram of the proposed BMC stack · ADR-004 · proposed, nothing is deployed
This document's reading, not ADR text:
Connections from the services to the broker, databases,
storage, mail and the calendar are drawn in P3 and P4.
Open (P-02): if internal is declared internal: true,
the AI containers cannot reach the provider, and a
later real SMTP server is unreachable.
Dashed outline: optional or not placed
